title: Agent tool selection
description: Decide which tool an agent should call next, how urgent the step is, and whether the step requires a tool at all. The choice task is the tool. The score task is urgency, not complexity: the generator's phrase banks are tone-shaped (calm → urgent), so an axis that is not urgency would label urgent-sounding text as something else. That is a documented design decision, see BACKLOG B-5.
